1.text: Nuko Mose abwira Abisirayeli ibyo Uwiteka yamutegetse byose.

2.text: Mose abwira abatware b'imiryango y'Abisirayeli ati “Iri ni ryo tegeko Uwiteka ategetse:

3.text: Umugabo nahiga Uwiteka umuhigo cyangwa niyibohesha indahiro, ntagace ku isezerano rye ngo aryonone, ahubwo ahigure ibyaturutse mu kanwa ke.

4.text: “Kandi umukobwa nahiga Uwiteka umuhigo, akibohesha isezerano akiri mu rugo rwa se mu bukumi bwe,

5.text: se akumva umuhigo we n'isezerano yibohesheje akamwihorera, imihigo ye yose n'isezerano yibohesheje ryose bizahama.

6.text: Ariko se namubuza ku munsi abyumviyeho, ntihazagire umuhigo we cyangwa isezerano yibohesheje gihama, kandi Uwiteka azamubabarira kuko se yamubujije.

7.text: “Cyangwa narongorwa n'umugabo akiboshywe n'umuhigo, cyangwa n'amagambo yaturumbukiye kuvuga yibohesheje,

8.text: umugabo we akabyumva, akamwihorera ku munsi abyumviyeho, imihigo ye n'isezerano yibohesheje bizahama.

9.text: Ariko umugabo we namubuza ku munsi abyumviyeho, azaba akuye umuhigo we yahize n'amagambo yaturumbukiye kuvuga yibohesheje, kandi Uwiteka azamubabarira.

10.text: “Ariko umuhigo w'umupfakazi cyangwa w'uwasenzwe, icyo yibohesheje cyose kizahama.

11.text: “Umugore nahigira umuhigo mu nzu y'umugabo we, cyangwa niyibohesherezayo indahiro,

12.text: umugabo we akabyumva akamwihorera ntamubuze, imihigo ye yose n'isezerano yibohesheje ryose bizahama.

13.text: Ariko umugabo we nabikura ku munsi yabyumviyeho, ibyaturutse mu kanwa ke byose byo ku mihigo ye cyangwa ku isezerano yibohesheje, ntibizahama kuko umugabo we yabikuye, kandi Uwiteka azamubabarira.

14.text: Umuhigo wose n'indahiro yose yiboheshereza kwibabaza, umugabo we yagikomeza cyangwa yagikura.

15.text: Ariko umugabo we namara iminsi amwihorera rwose, azaba akomeje imihigo ye yose cyangwa ibyo yibohesheje byose bimuboshye. Kuko yamwihoreye ku munsi yabyumviyeho, azaba abikomeje.

16.text: Ariko nabikura yari yarabyumvise, azagibwaho no gukiranirwa k'umugore we.”

17.text: Ayo ni yo mategeko Uwiteka yategetse Mose, ategeka ibyo umugabo n'umugore we, n'iby'umukobwa na se akiri inkumi mu rugo rwa se.
